definitions.explanation: An elastic device that returns to its shape after being compressed or stretched.
The quality of being able to bounce back.

examples.japanese: ベッドのばねが{壊|こわ}れた。
この{椅子|いす}はばねが{効|き}いている。
{足|あし}のばねを{使|つか}って{跳|と}ぶ。
examples.english: I jump using the spring in my legs.

notes:
ばね refers to a mechanical spring or springiness. Can also be written as バネ or {発条|ばね}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ばねが{効|き}く: to have good springs, to be springy
- ばねが{壊|こわ}れる: the spring breaks
- {足|あし}のばね: leg spring (jumping ability)

COMPOUNDS:
- コイルばね: coil spring
- {板|いた}ばね: leaf spring
- ばね{仕掛|じか}け: spring-loaded

FIGURATIVE:
ばね is often used figuratively to describe resilience or the ability to bounce back from adversity.
